exposure: Fetal station at onset of labor
cohort: 100 primigravidae at 37 to 41 weeks of gestation with vertex presentation and spontaneous onset of labor without Antepartum or Intrapartum risk factors at the Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Labour delivery and recovery (LDR) rooms at Gayatri Vidya Parishad Medical College, Visakhapatnam from January 2022 to December 2022
finding: The study found a relationship between high fetal station at onset of labor and certain labor outcomes, including NICU admissions due to meconium-stained amniotic fluid and low APGAR scores.
